newsitem.title: USA: PolyMedica says executives buy 100,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: PolyMedica says executives buy 100,000 shares.

text.p: PolyMedica Industries Inc said Monday its senior management had purchased 100,000 common shares of the company in the open market.
The purchase was made on January 24 and represented 1.2 percent of the company's 8.4 million common shares outstanding, it said.
Steven Lee, chairman and chief executive officer, said the purchase "is a strong indicator of senior management's confidence in the company's growth."
PolyMedica develops, manufactures and distributes specialized healthcare products.
